brief_task_create: A short, self-contained explanation of the action or intended outcome for the person opening the task. Plain text, at most 600 Unicode characters; usually one to three sentences. Required unless status is inbox; Inbox may omit it. Put supporting detail in notes. Do not use a placeholder or copy the title just to satisfy the requirement.
brief_task_patch: Replace the short human brief, at most 600 Unicode characters of plain text. Omit/null preserves it. An empty string clears it only if the resulting status is inbox. Moving out of Inbox requires a nonblank brief. Read the existing record before replacement; put supporting detail in notes.
brief_project_create: Required short explanation of the project's intended outcome for the person opening it. Plain text, one to 600 Unicode characters; usually one to three sentences. Put supporting detail in notes. Do not use a placeholder or copy the title just to satisfy the requirement.
brief_project_patch: Replace the short human explanation of the project's intended outcome, at most 600 Unicode characters of plain text. Omit/null preserves it; a supplied value must be nonblank. Read the existing project before replacement.
brief_repeat_create: Short human explanation of the work for each occurrence, at most 600 Unicode characters of plain text. Required for non-Inbox defaults. When adopting an existing task, omission/null inherits its brief; the resulting non-Inbox defaults must still have a nonblank brief. Do not invent occurrence-specific facts.
brief_repeat_patch: Human brief for occurrences in the selected scope, at most 600 Unicode characters of plain text. Omit/null preserves each existing segment's brief independently. A supplied value replaces it subject to occurrence overrides. Empty clears only where the resulting default status is inbox. Prefer the top-level brief field for a brief-only change.
brief_scoped: With action=edit, replace only the brief in the selected scope without replacing the rule or other defaults. At most 600 Unicode characters of plain text. Omit/null makes no brief change; empty clears only where the resulting status is inbox. Following/all edits preserve individual occurrence overrides. Do not also supply template.brief.
notes_create: Optional supporting instructions, constraints, references, and detail useful to the person doing the work. Up to 10000 Unicode characters. Keep simple content plain; use lightweight Markdown when it improves scanning. The brief carries the short explanation. Omission creates empty notes.
notes_patch: Replace the human supporting notes, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Omit/null preserves; an empty string clears. Read the existing record and retain still-useful detail. Use lightweight Markdown when helpful; keep agent-only background and handoff context in agent_notes.
notes_repeat: Human supporting instructions for each occurrence, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Lightweight Markdown is supported. Omission means empty notes, including in a replacement template; read and retain wanted notes before replacing a template. Keep occurrence-specific updates on the individual task.
agent_task_create: Required nonblank handoff for an assistant without the conversation, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Preserve relevant background, decisions, constraints, uncertainty, and sources. For Inbox, retain why this was captured and what remains unresolved. One factual sentence is enough for a simple task; do not invent context or copy a transcript.
agent_project_create: Required nonblank project handoff for an assistant without the conversation, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Preserve relevant outcome context, decisions, constraints, uncertainty, and sources. Refer to member tasks instead of copying their complete contents. A short factual account is enough when little context exists.
agent_task_patch: Replace the current agent handoff, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Omit/null preserves it; supplied text must be nonblank. Required when moving an Inbox task to another status if its current handoff is empty. Read the existing handoff, reconcile changed facts, and retain useful context; do not append a transcript or obsolete history.
agent_project_patch: Replace the current project handoff, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Omit/null preserves it; supplied text must be nonblank. Read the existing handoff, reconcile changed facts, and retain relevant outcome context, decisions, constraints, uncertainty, and sources.
agent_repeat_create: Required nonblank handoff shared by occurrences, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Preserve the recurring work's purpose, relevant decisions, constraints, uncertainty, and sources. Describe shared context, not invented progress or facts about a particular occurrence. A short factual account is enough when little context exists.
agent_repeat_patch: Shared handoff for occurrences in the selected scope, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Omit/null preserves each existing segment's handoff; supplied text must be nonblank. Read before replacing and preserve individual occurrence overrides. A newly clarified Inbox default needs a handoff if its current one is empty.
agent_scoped: With action=edit, replace only the agent handoff in the selected scope without replacing the rule or other defaults. Omit/null preserves; supplied text must be nonblank and at most 10000 Unicode characters. Read current context first. Following/all edits preserve individual occurrence overrides. Do not also supply template.agent_notes.
agent_human: Optional context for an assistant without the conversation, up to 10000 Unicode characters. Omit/null preserves on updates; an empty string clears. This field is owner-readable.
url: Absolute HTTP/HTTPS URL, up to 2048 characters, with no embedded credentials. Use an exact user-provided or observed destination; do not guess paths or identifiers. GTD stores the link without fetching or verifying it.
link_label: Optional concise name of the resource or its purpose, up to 120 Unicode characters. Use a human-readable label; omit internal tool identifiers, verification diagnostics, and unsupported claims that a link was checked.
links_create: Useful resources in display order, up to 20 links. Use concise labels. Omission creates an empty list; in a replacement template it removes prior links, so retain links you still want.
links_patch: Replace the resource list, up to 20 links. Omit/null preserves; [] clears. Read the existing record and retain links still needed. Inability to open a private link does not establish that it is broken.
sessions_create: Optional calendar-event links. These are references only; GTD does not create, move, or synchronize events. Omission creates an empty list.
sessions_patch: Replace the calendar-event link list. Omit/null preserves; [] clears. Read the existing list first. These links do not create, move, or synchronize calendar events.
calendar_event: Optional link to this block's calendar event. Reference only: GTD does not synchronize the event. In a replacement block, omit/null removes this reference; retain it when replacing the list if still wanted.
reason: Concise basis for this change. Identify relevant user direction or evidence and make consequential agent inference explicit. Describe why this record changed; do not copy the conversation or claim unsupported progress.
result_create: Optional factual outcome of completed work, at most 2000 Unicode characters; valid only when status is done. Include only supported results. The presence of a result does not itself establish completion.
result_patch: Replace the factual outcome of completed work, at most 2000 Unicode characters. Omit/null preserves; empty clears. Valid only when the resulting status is done. Correcting the result does not change the recorded completion time.
completed_at: Server-recorded completion time; may be unknown for a legacy completed record. Reopening clears it, while history retains the prior completion. Correcting completion_result preserves this timestamp.
version: Revision to supply as expected_version when editing this record. Committed changes, including undo, advance the version; undo does not restore an older version number.
status_patch: Omit/null preserves workflow state. Use done only with evidence this particular action is complete. Explicit blocked sets a manual hold; next releases a manual hold but still respects unfinished prerequisites and future availability. Omit status on unrelated edits.
started: Confirm this task's work actually began. Omit/null preserves. True records progress without guessing when; false resets the marker and actual start time. A scheduled time or general progress on related work is not evidence this task started.
started_at: Known actual start, optionally date-only. Supplying it confirms started. Omit/null preserves; clear_planning=[started_at] clears the time without resetting the marker. If the start time is unknown, use started=true without inventing a time.
due_create: Optional real deadline as YYYY-MM-DD. Without deadline_time, the entire local day is available; add deadline_time only when a clock time is known. Do not substitute a review date or intended work date.
due_patch: Real deadline as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit/null preserves; clear_due_date removes it and its deadline_time/safety_buffer. Without deadline_time, the entire local day is available. Changing a work block does not move this deadline.
estimated_minutes: Estimated remaining active work in whole minutes, from 0 to 5256000. Required with effort for unfinished, unarchived Next/Blocked/Waiting work. Use a grounded estimate; elapsed waiting or scheduled time does not count as completed work. Omit/null preserves on updates.
effort: Demandingness: trivial, low, medium, high, or extreme; independent of duration and importance. Required with estimated_minutes for unfinished, unarchived Next/Blocked/Waiting work. Use a grounded estimate. Omit/null preserves on updates.
replacement_template: Replacement task defaults, not a general partial patch; read the current affected defaults and retain wanted fields. Omitted/null brief, agent_notes, and planning fields preserve their values independently in each segment. Other template fields retain replacement semantics. Use top-level brief or agent_notes for a content-only scoped update; clear_planning explicitly clears optional planning fields.
replacement_rule: Replacement rule, not a partial patch; read the current series first.
scope: Edit this occurrence, this and following occurrences, all defaults, or one version-selected segment's brief. Skip/unskip require this; pause/resume/end require all. Segment scope permits only a brief-only edit and requires segment_from.
original_date: Required for this/following scope; immutable original date identifies the occurrence after rescheduling. Omit for all or segment scope.
segment_from: With scope=segment and action=edit, select the segment whose from value was returned at the supplied expected_version. This is a selector within that series version, not a permanent identity. Only a top-level brief edit is allowed; a stale version or missing boundary fails without retargeting.
preview_template: Optional defaults with rule to preview resolved timing and daylight-saving adjustments without saving. Content fields may be omitted for a timing-only preview. Previewing does not satisfy creation requirements or create stored tasks.
record_limit: Maximum records to return: default 20, at most 100. Each returned current record includes its brief, notes, and agent_notes. The response-size budget may return fewer records; follow next_cursor to continue.
record_cursor: Pass next_cursor here with unchanged selectors and filters to continue the same frozen snapshot. Omit to refresh. A remaining cursor means more matching records exist; do not claim the list is complete.
task_ids: Select 1–50 distinct stored tasks. Cannot be combined with task_id. Results remain paginated; follow next_cursor to receive all matching records.
occurrence_limit: Maximum rows to return: default 20, at most 100. Stored occurrences and returned defaults include complete brief, notes, and agent_notes. The response-size budget may return fewer rows; follow the returned cursor. Preview rows are not stored tasks.
segments_only: With series_id, read a paginated snapshot of every retained default segment, including historical segments. Use cursor/limit to continue. Returned from values select a segment only within the returned series version. Incompatible with rule, template, from, or through. This mode does not list stored occurrences.
sync_cursor: Omit for an initial consistent snapshot. Pass next_cursor to continue, or the completed checkpoint to read subsequent changes. Save local state and its cursor/checkpoint together. Buffer split transactions until transaction_end; on reset_required rebuild from a fresh snapshot.
sync_limit: Maximum rows for this page, subject to the existing count and response-size limits. Record snapshots and record-bearing deltas include complete content; deletions use tombstones. A page ending before transaction_end must not be applied as a completed transaction.
change_id: Select one immutable audit event. With detail=full, return its exact before/after data, including agent notes. Historical fields may differ from current contracts; current state must be read before another edit.
audit_detail: Summary returns audit metadata; full returns exact historical before/after values. This setting affects audit history only, not current record completeness.
receipt: Confirmation of a committed mutation: record identifiers, versions, change identifiers, and replay state. This is not a current full record. A replay returns the original result; read current state before making a new decision.
